exposure: Uterine scarring from prior caesarean section
outcome: Preference for caesarean section or vaginal birth after caesarean section (VBAC)
Progress in the first and second stages of vaginal delivery
cohort: 679 pregnant women with scarred uteruses from Moulay Ali Cherif Provincial Hospital, Rashidiya, Morocco
finding: Maternal age, gestational age, and the interval since the last caesarean section were significant factors in predicting preference for caesarean section among pregnant women with scarred uteruses.
